**Coca-Cola had the higher operating margin in fiscal 2025, by about 25.3 percentage points.** The Coca-Cola figure is my own estimate, assembled from quarterly results I recall but did not verify. I don't have a confirmed full-year 2025 figure for it.

**Walmart (fiscal 2025, ended January 31, 2025)**
- Operating income was about $29.35B on revenue of about $681.0B.
- That gives an operating margin of about 4.3%.

**Coca-Cola (fiscal 2025, ended December 31, 2025)**
- Adding the four quarters gives revenue of about $47.95B:
  - Q1 about $11.13B
  - Q2 about $12.54B
  - Q3 about $12.46B
  - Q4 about $11.8B
- Adding the four quarters gives operating income of about $14.2B:
  - Q1 about $3.66B
  - Q2 about $4.28B
  - Q3 about $3.98B
  - Q4 about $2.3B
- That gives an operating margin of about 29.6%. This is well above 2024's roughly 21.2%.

**Difference:** about 29.6% − 4.3% ≈ 25.3 percentage points.
